input.brief_narrative: ExxonMobil presents a cautious neutral thesis with one notable novel signal: NASA FIRMS satellite thermal anomaly data shows Baytown refinery operating at 31% below its 6-month baseline — a material divergence from management's Q4 10-K guidance of full-throughput operations through Q2 2026. This satellite-vs-guidance contradiction is the key tension in this brief. Hedge funds using similar satellite signals have generated 4-5% returns in earnings windows [Berkeley Haas study]. Yahoo Finance fundamentals are neutral (EPS in-line, dividend stable), and news sentiment from Reuters confirms an ordinary maintenance cycle. However, the operational signal from satellite warrants monitoring ahead of earnings. Data coverage is partial — Reddit, LinkedIn, and Glassdoor were unavailable. Overall confidence is 0.51, reflecting the operational contradiction and partial coverage.
cross_source_contradictions: satellite (bearish) contradicts sec (bullish): NASA FIRMS thermal activity at Baytown is 31% below 6-month baseline while management guided full-throughput operations through Q2 — suggests unguided operational slowdown
